work.composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc anchors with central target
work.description: Layered printed ephemera and physical objects—compact discs, archery targets, Rolling Stones tongue-and-lips logos, an Arsenal badge, and an engineering-drawing warplane—are collaged across a black ground with vertical red and yellow paper strips. Gold glitter material occupies the center, flanked by four silver CDs along the lower register and a small football at lower right.
work.title: Tongue and Plane
